ChapterCompletedDef.description: The player has completed a chapter: they have its advancement ``realmforge:chapter/<id>``.
ChapterCompletedDef.title: ChapterCompletedDef

DepthDef.description: Deeper is stronger: below ``below_y``, a mob is one level higher for every ``blocks_per_level`` blocks.

below_y.description: The height below which depth adds levels.
below_y.title: Below Y

blocks_per_level.description: Blocks below below_y for each level more (1 or more).
blocks_per_level.title: Blocks Per Level

DepthDef.title: DepthDef

HasAdvancementDef.description: The player has earned an advancement: a realm's unlock, ``realmforge:realm/<realm>``, for example.
HasAdvancementDef.title: HasAdvancementDef

LevelAtLeastDef.description: The player's character level is at least ``level``.

level.description: The lowest character level that passes.
level.title: Level

LevelAtLeastDef.title: LevelAtLeastDef

MobLevelRuleDef.description:
How the level of a mob spawning in the dimension follows from where it spawns: the level at the
dimension's origin, one level more every ``blocks_per_level`` blocks of horizontal distance from it, more with
depth, a random spread of ``jitter`` levels either way, all clamped to ``min_level`` .. ``max_level``.

blocks_per_level.description: Horizontal distance from the origin, in blocks, for each level more (1 or more).
blocks_per_level.title: Blocks Per Level

jitter.description: Each mob's level is up to this many levels higher or lower, at random (0: none).
jitter.title: Jitter

max_level.description: The highest level in the dimension.
max_level.title: Max Level

min_level.description: The lowest level in the dimension.
min_level.title: Min Level

origin_level.description: Level at the origin (x 0, z 0), above the depth line.
origin_level.title: Origin Level

MobLevelRuleDef.title: MobLevelRuleDef

description:
The gameplay rules of one dimension, which the ``dimension`` field names: the rule for mob levels and what a
player needs to enter it. At most one entry per dimension.

access.description: Optional: what a player needs to enter the dimension, every requirement at once; refused on every way in (a portal, a command, a warp). A realm's rules name its unlock advancement (realm portal spec).
access.title: Access

dimension.description: The dimension these rules are for, e.g. minecraft:overworld.
dimension.title: Dimension

id.description: Lowercase snake_case id; becomes realmforge:<id>. Must equal the file name.
id.title: Id

mob_levels.description: Optional: the level of mobs spawning there. Without it, mobs have no level.

title: DimensionRulesDef
